title: coresentinel verify reports a false FAIL on every Pest project
problem: Brand New ERP P0 has 143 passing Pest tests, but coresentinel verify reported 'Security / Unit Test FAIL 0/25 - test suite exited 1'. Root cause: coresentinel_evidence.py line 169 probes only vendor/bin/phpunit and runs it. Pest ships phpunit as a transitive dependency and its phpunit shim exits 1 with 'Please run ./vendor/bin/pest instead'. The detector therefore selects a runner guaranteed to fail. Fix: probe vendor/bin/pest before vendor/bin/phpunit. A green suite reported as FAIL is worse than UNKNOWN because it trains the reader to ignore verification output
